basic_info.description: This charming Lakeside 3 bedroom home has been owned and cherished by a family for over 60 years! It has great curb appeal and wonderful potential. Inside are newly refinished hardwood floors throughout and abundant natural light. The main level features a spacious living room with a cozy wood-burning fireplace, formal dining room, and an updated kitchen with a separate breakfast room perfect for enjoying morning coffee. The middle level has two nicely sized bedrooms and a full bath. The upper split level has a large primary bedroom with a sun room off of it and another full bath for added convenience.  There are new modern light fixtures throughout.  Off the kitchen on a lower level is a family room. It has access to an enclosed expansive backyard perfect for barbecues and outdoor gatherings. There is a garage for one car and a driveway that fits a second car.  A washer and dryer and plenty of storage are in the garage.  This home is close to MUNI lines, BART and the 280 entrance as well as Lakeside Village, West Portal and the Stonestown mall. Make this gem your forever home!
